avis.auteur: Love Your Skin Love Your Life
avis.texte: The Exuviance Advanced Total Correct Serum is primarily an exfoliating powerhouse and that message is not clear. This product features glycolic acid and gluconolactone as its key players. These ingredients work to gently resurface the skin, leaving it smoother and more even in tone. What I love about this serum is that while it's actively exfoliating, it doesn't forget to hydrate. On top of the exfoliation and hydration, you also get a nice dose of anti-aging peptides, which can help to firm and improve skin elasticity over time. The added botanical extracts, like peony root and mallow flower, provide soothing and antioxidant benefits, which balance out the more active ingredients. However, this serum does lean heavily into exfoliation and botanical ingredients, so if you have sensitive skin, it's important to patch test first. The glycolic acid can be a bit intense for some, and the peppermint extract might be irritating for very reactive skin. But if your skin can handle it, this serum can be a great way to address texture and fine lines, leaving your complexion looking more refined and glowing.

It blended in well with my skin and didn't leave behind a residue which was appreciated. I didn't see much of the results I expected but the product does leave my skin feeling soft and moisturized.

avis.titre: My favorite product from the kit
avis.texte: This is my favorite product from the kit. I use it in the am and pm, after washing my face, and it is incredibly light and non oily. The texture is great. It makes my skin feel super soft and my skin looks great now without makeup. I would recommend this to a friend.

This serum is great quality, down to the pump. I love pumps like this, that are easy to control the amount that comes out. I love the feel of it and that as soon as it dries there is no sticky feeling or residue hanging around. I can't really smell anything with this product, if it's there it's so mild that it isn't a factor. My face has been showing signs of aging and I feel like this is helping me to reverse it a little. I'm happy with this and the whole product line! I was given this product in exchange for my honest review!

I been using this product for over 3 weeks now and can tell there is definitely a smoother look to the under of my eyes and on the corner of my eyes where line are appearing making me always look like I'm tired. Easy to spread on without leaving a build up once I apply my foundation.
I liked the feeling of this serum. It wasn't too heavy or sticky which some others can be. A small amount went a long way and which is great because I don't like skin care feeling heavy

avis.titre: Helps aid in younger looking skin
avis.texte: I like this advanced total correct serum because it helps skin look firmer. I received this complimentary to use - give my honest opinion. It Has hyaluronic acid to hydrate & plump fine lines & wrinkles. It has other vitamins & peptides to help aid in younger looking skin.

Started using the Exuviance Advanced Total Correct Serum, and I'm loving it! It's super lightweight and sinks right in—no heavy feeling. My skin already looks a little brighter, and the texture is smoothing out. Excited to see what it does with more time!
Nice pump bottle. Cute shade of pink for the bottle. My skin looks a bit brighter since using it. Absorbs quickly. Light scent. Texture is very nice.

Well I have to say that I have a big time fetish when it comes to face serums. This one I do like is it one of my number ones. No it does not absorb as fast as I would like it to so it makes it a little bit hard in the mornings to add moisturizer and still be able to put makeup on. It leaves my face very tacky and damp feeling but using it at night was just perfect. I love the effectiveness of this. It definitely plumps up almost every one of my fine lines and definitely helps decrease the deepness of some of the deeper lines in my face. Not a lot but it has shown some improvement. The packaging is amazing. I love the pump. It's easy to distribute on my face. All in all this is a very good product. I highly recommend this to all face types

I received this product for free from Exuviance in exchange for my honest review. I enjoyed using these products, but I do not see any difference in my skin after using these products for over a month. Also, they have a scent to them that I don't like.

I've been using this for about a month , the serum is non scented , and absorbs easily without any greasy or sticky feeling , my skin def feels nice , and I can't say that I've noticed a whole lot in a month of use but I do think that it helps !

avis.titre: The perfect all in one serum!
avis.texte: I love peptides for my face! Exuviance launched a serum that contains MicroDPeptides and it is very effective. My forehead wrinkles is less noticeable! After two weeks my cheeks and pores have plumped up and look smoother. I love this serum in the daytime. The peptides really work and they added another favorite ingredient: Hyaluronic Acid, plus Collagen and Elastin. The advanced total correct serum is a super smoothing all in one serum. Nice size too - 1oz bottle of serum!

I received this product free in exchange for my honest review. I generally really enjoyed this product. The Advanced Total Correct Serum made my skin (gently) peel more than any skincare I've ever used. Within 8 hours on day one, I noticed peeling and skin on my chin and forehead gently rubbed off upon firm pressure. My skin feels softer and more fresh. However, while I love it, I am noticing a worsening of my rosacea after 1.5 weeks of use so I switched to using it every other night. I plan to continue to use it though and it's perfect for a skin refresh! Note: it does contain peppermint oil so I do not advise for sensitive skin.

The total correct serum to was good, but unfortunately, after a couple weeks, I had to stop using all of the products in the line. I was getting bumps and red skin. I do not consider myself to have sensitive skin, but this definitely bothered me.

This serum has many benefits! I have found once applying I need to let it dry completely and sit before applying any other products. I have had some issues with pilling otherwise. I tend to not use this in the morning if I plan on on wearing makeup. At night it is wonderful to layer up under the moisturizer. I look forward to continue using this product to see the full benefit on my skin.

avis.titre: Nice formula is a bit sticky
avis.texte: I received this product complimentary from @Influenster and @Exuviance in exchange for my honest opinion. I recently started using Exuviance Age Reverse+ Advanced Total Correct Serum to help with my aging skin, and I've been really pleased with the improvements I'm seeing in my complexion. This serum is designed specifically to target multiple signs of aging, and after using it consistently, I can already tell that it's working. To get the most out of this product, I recommend applying it right after washing your face. You don't need much—a small amount about the size of a dime is enough to cover your face. The serum is packed with ingredients that are specifically formulated to address 10 visible signs of aging, including improving skin texture, making it feel more supple, and reducing the look of fine lines, wrinkles, and deep lines. It also helps with overall skin firmness, volume, and radiance, while tackling uneven skin tone and enhancing clarity. One of the standout features of this serum is the use of a cutting-edge ingredient called MicroDiPeptide229 technology, which plays a big role in boosting the appearance and feel of the skin. This breakthrough technology helps to rejuvenate the skin, giving it a lifted and more youthful look. If you're dealing with any signs of aging, whether it's sagging, dullness, or wrinkles, I highly recommend trying this serum. It's been a great addition to my routine, and I'm excited to see even more improvement as I continue using it!

avis.titre: Your All-in-One Solution for Youthful, Radiant Skin
avis.texte: I was gifted the Exuviance Advanced Total Correct Serum for review, and after using it consistently for two weeks, I noticed a visible difference in my skin's texture and radiance. The lightweight formula absorbs quickly, making it easy to layer under my moisturizer. The MicroDiPeptide229 technology combined with PHA and Hyaluronic Acid helps improve firmness and reduce fine lines, giving my skin a smoother and more even appearance. It's a great addition to any anti-aging routine, especially for those targeting multiple signs of aging at once.

I received this product for Free and Exchange for an honest review. These product has a light clean scent and a little goes a long way. One little pump usually did the trick. It applied easily. While it felt nice during use, I don't feel like it changed the appearance of my skin even after over 2 weeks of use.
The serum smells great and the texture is lightweight. The packaging is cute and i have noticed improvements in my skin. There are a lot of ingredients that make your skin nicer.
I really like the way this feels on my skin. It's easy to use. It smells great. The container is perfect. I would highly recommend this to anyone in the future.

The Advance Total Correct Serum is a very lightweight serum that absorbs easily into the skin, contains AHA and a safe for sensitive skin. I didn't notice any issues with my skin. You do need to shake the bottle before using to ensure it's evenly dispersed. I found this anbsorbed into the skin nicely when pressed in. I have also been using this on my husband and have noticed his skin appearing softer and smoother. Also, you must wear sunscreen after application. I didn't notice any fragrance or overpowering scent, just a clean smell when using.

I'm thoroughly impressed with Exuviance Advanced Total Correct Serum! This potent serum has been a game-changer for my skin, delivering noticeable results in just a few short weeks. Its lightweight, non-greasy texture absorbs quickly, making it perfect for daily use. The transformation has been remarkable - fine lines and wrinkles appear smoother, dark spots and hyperpigmentation are fading, and my complexion looks brighter and more even. My skin feels hydrated, plump, and supple, with a noticeable improvement in texture and tone. What I love most is how effortlessly it fits into my skincare routine, layering seamlessly under moisturizer and makeup. The results speak for themselves - I've received countless compliments on my glowing skin! I highly recommend Exuviance Advanced Total Correct Serum to anyone seeking to address fine lines, dark spots, uneven skin tone, and hydration. It's a must-have in any skincare arsenal.

I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. This serum is smooth and the packaging makes dispensing the product a breeze. It is easy to rub in. Did not care for the smell but thankfully it dissipated quickly. This would be a good serum in the summer but it left me feeling a bit dry before applying my normal moisturizer.
